evidence.observation: Before the disturbance, PDI702 was 2.9 mbar, PY23 501.0 mbar, and reflux/distillate flows were 0.2/0.4 L/h.
PDI702 rose to 7.2 mbar and PY23 to 507.6 mbar while both flows were zero; both flows remained zero at 360 s as PY23 reached 511.7 mbar.
T701 fell from 440.0 to 320.7 °C, with T704/T706 falling to 67.0/66.7 °C, indicating a thermal disturbance accompanying the pressure/flow interruption.
Pressure and flows have recovered: PDI702 3.0 mbar, PY23 500.0 mbar, FT703/FT704 0.2/0.5 L/h; T701 is 434.8 °C. Recovery does not erase the earlier execution disturbance.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol and heater/valve command logs are needed to determine whether the interruption was commanded; pressure-path inspection or independent pressure checks would distinguish a transient restriction from other faults. Confirm T701 calibration and obtain composition measurements and target specifications to assess separation.
